theorem putnam_1965_a6
    (u v m : ℝ)
    (hu : 0 < u)
    (hv : 0 < v)
    (hm : 1 < m) :
    (∃ᵉ (x > 0) (y > 0),
      u * x + v * y = 1 ∧
      x ^ m + y ^ m = 1 ∧
      u = x ^ (m - 1) ∧
      v = y ^ (m - 1)) ↔
    ∃ n, u ^ n + v ^ n = 1 ∧ m⁻¹ + n⁻¹ = 1 :=
  by
 
  have h_main_forward : (∃ᵉ (x > 0) (y > 0), u * x + v * y = 1 ∧ x ^ m + y ^ m = 1 ∧ u = x ^ (m - 1) ∧ v = y ^ (m - 1)) → (∃ n, u ^ n + v ^ n = 1 ∧ m⁻¹ + n⁻¹ = 1) := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄⟩ := h
    have h₅ : m - 1 > 0 := by linarith
    have h₆ : 0 < x := by linarith
    have h₇ : 0 < y := by linarith
    have h₈ : 0 < x ^ (m - 1) := by positivity
    have h₉ : 0 < y ^ (m - 1) := by positivity
    
    have h₁₀ : ∃ n : ℝ, u ^ n + v ^ n = 1 ∧ m⁻¹ + n⁻¹ = 1 := by
      use m / (m - 1)
      have h₁₁ : u ^ (m / (m - 1)) + v ^ (m / (m - 1)) = 1 := by
        calc
          u ^ (m / (m - 1)) + v ^ (m / (m - 1)) = (x ^ (m - 1)) ^ (m / (m - 1)) + (y ^ (m - 1)) ^ (m / (m - 1)) := by
            rw [h₃, h₄]
          _ = x ^ ((m - 1) * (m / (m - 1))) + y ^ ((m - 1) * (m / (m - 1))) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt h₆), ← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt h₇)]
            <;> field_simp [h₅.ne']
            <;> ring
          _ = x ^ m + y ^ m := by
            have h₁₂ : (m - 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
            have h₁₃ : (m - 1 : ℝ) * (m / (m - 1)) = m := by
              field_simp [h₁₂]
              <;> ring
            rw [h₁₃]
          _ = 1 := by
            rw [h₂]
      have h₁₂ : m⁻¹ + (m / (m - 1))⁻¹ = 1 := by
        have h₁₃ : m - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
        have h₁₄ : (m / (m - 1) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
          field_simp [h₁₃]
          <;> linarith
        field_simp [h₁₃, h₁₄]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> field_simp [h₁₃]
        <;> linarith
      exact ⟨h₁₁, h₁₂⟩
    exact h₁₀
  
  have h_main_backward : (∃ n, u ^ n + v ^ n = 1 ∧ m⁻¹ + n⁻¹ = 1) → (∃ᵉ (x > 0) (y > 0), u * x + v * y = 1 ∧ x ^ m + y ^ m = 1 ∧ u = x ^ (m - 1) ∧ v = y ^ (m - 1)) := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨n, hn₁, hn₂⟩ := h
    have h₁ : m - 1 > 0 := by linarith
    have h₂ : (m - 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have h₃ : n = m / (m - 1) := by
      have h₄ : m⁻¹ + n⁻¹ = 1 := hn₂
      have h₅ : n ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra h₅
        rw [h₅] at h₄
        norm_num at h₄ ⊢
        <;>
        (try norm_num at hn₁ ⊢) <;>
        (try linarith) <;>
        (try field_simp [h₂] at h₄ ⊢) <;>
        (try nlinarith)
      have h₆ : m ≠ 0 := by linarith
      have h₇ : n + m = m * n := by
        have h₇₁ : m⁻¹ + n⁻¹ = 1 := hn₂
        have h₇₂ : n ≠ 0 := h₅
        have h₇₃ : m ≠ 0 := h₆
        field_simp [h₇₂, h₇₃] at h₇₁
        nlinarith
      have h₈ : n = m / (m - 1) := by
        have h₈₁ : n + m = m * n := h₇
        have h₈₂ : n = m / (m - 1) := by
          have h₈₃ : m - 1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
          field_simp [h₈₃] at h₈₁ ⊢
          nlinarith
        exact h₈₂
      exact h₈
    have h₄ : u ^ n + v ^ n = 1 := hn₁
    have h₅ : n = m / (m - 1) := h₃
    have h₆ : ∃ (x : ℝ), x > 0 ∧ u = x ^ (m - 1) := by
      refine' ⟨u ^ (1 / (m - 1)), by positivity, _⟩
      have h₇ : (u ^ (1 / (m - 1)) : ℝ) ^ (m - 1) = u := by
        have h₈ : (m - 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
        have h₉ : (u ^ (1 / (m - 1)) : ℝ) ^ (m - 1) = u := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hu)]
          <;> field_simp [h₈]
          <;> ring
        exact h₉
      linarith
    have h₇ : ∃ (y : ℝ), y > 0 ∧ v = y ^ (m - 1) := by
      refine' ⟨v ^ (1 / (m - 1)), by positivity, _⟩
      have h₈ : (v ^ (1 / (m - 1)) : ℝ) ^ (m - 1) = v := by
        have h₉ : (m - 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
        have h₁₀ : (v ^ (1 / (m - 1)) : ℝ) ^ (m - 1) = v := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hv)]
          <;> field_simp [h₉]
          <;> ring
        exact h₁₀
      linarith
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := h₆
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := h₇
    have h₈ : u * x + v * y = 1 := by
      have h₉ : n = m / (m - 1) := h₃
      have h₁₀ : u ^ n + v ^ n = 1 := hn₁
      have h₁₁ : u * x + v * y = 1 := by
        have h₁₂ : x = u ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by

          have h₁₅ : u > 0 := hu
          have h₁₆ : (m - 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
          have h₁₇ : x = u ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
            have h₁₈ : x = u ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
              calc
                x = (x ^ (m - 1)) ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
                  have h₁₉ : x > 0 := hx
                  have h₂₀ : (x ^ (m - 1) : ℝ) > 0 := by positivity
                  have h₂₁ : (x ^ (m - 1) : ℝ) ^ (1 / (m - 1)) = x := by
                    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt h₁₉)]
                    <;> field_simp [h₁₆]
                    <;> ring
                  rw [h₂₁]
                _ = u ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
                  rw [hx']
                  <;> simp [h₁₆]
                  <;> field_simp [h₁₆]
                  <;> ring
            exact h₁₈
          exact h₁₇
        have h₁₃ : y = v ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
          have h₁₄ : v = y ^ (m - 1) := hy'
          have h₁₅ : y > 0 := hy
          have h₁₆ : v > 0 := hv
          have h₁₇ : (m - 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
          have h₁₈ : y = v ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
            have h₁₉ : y = (y ^ (m - 1)) ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
              have h₂₀ : y > 0 := hy
              have h₂₁ : (y ^ (m - 1) : ℝ) > 0 := by positivity
              have h₂₂ : (y ^ (m - 1) : ℝ) ^ (1 / (m - 1)) = y := by
                rw [← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt h₂₀)]
                <;> field_simp [h₁₇]
                <;> ring
              rw [h₂₂]
            rw [h₁₉, hy']
            <;> simp [h₁₇]
            <;> field_simp [h₁₇]
            <;> ring
          exact h₁₈
        calc
          u * x + v * y = u * (u ^ (1 / (m - 1))) + v * (v ^ (1 / (m - 1))) := by rw [h₁₂, h₁₃]
          _ = u ^ (1 + 1 / (m - 1)) + v ^ (1 + 1 / (m - 1)) := by
            have h₁₉ : u > 0 := hu
            have h₂₀ : v > 0 := hv
            have h₂₁ : (m - 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
            have h₂₂ : (u : ℝ) ^ (1 + 1 / (m - 1)) = u * u ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
              have h₂₃ : (u : ℝ) ^ (1 + 1 / (m - 1)) = (u : ℝ) ^ 1 * (u : ℝ) ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
                rw [Real.rpow_add (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < u)]
                <;> field_simp [h₂₁]
                <;> ring
              rw [h₂₃]
              <;> simp [Real.rpow_one]
              <;> ring
            have h₂₃ : (v : ℝ) ^ (1 + 1 / (m - 1)) = v * v ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
              have h₂₄ : (v : ℝ) ^ (1 + 1 / (m - 1)) = (v : ℝ) ^ 1 * (v : ℝ) ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
                rw [Real.rpow_add (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < v)]
                <;> field_simp [h₂₁]
                <;> ring
              rw [h₂₄]
              <;> simp [Real.rpow_one]
              <;> ring
            rw [h₂₂, h₂₃]
            <;> ring
          _ = u ^ n + v ^ n := by
            have h₁₉ : n = m / (m - 1) := h₃
            have h₂₀ : 1 + 1 / (m - 1) = n := by
              rw [h₁₉]
              have h₂₁ : (m - 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
              field_simp [h₂₁]
              <;> ring
              <;> field_simp [h₂₁]
              <;> ring
            rw [h₂₀]
          _ = 1 := by
            exact h₁₀
      exact h₁₁
    have h₉ : x ^ m + y ^ m = 1 := by
      have h₁₀ : n = m / (m - 1) := h₃
      have h₁₁ : u ^ n + v ^ n = 1 := hn₁
      have h₁₂ : x ^ m + y ^ m = 1 := by
        have h₁₃ : x = u ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
          have h₁₄ : u = x ^ (m - 1) := hx'
          have h₁₅ : x > 0 := hx
          have h₁₆ : u > 0 := hu
          have h₁₇ : (m - 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
          have h₁₈ : x = u ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
            have h₁₉ : x = (x ^ (m - 1)) ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by

              have h₂₁ : (x ^ (m - 1) : ℝ) > 0 := by positivity

                rw [← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt h₂₀)]
                <;> field_simp [h₁₇]
                <;> ring
              rw [h₂₂]
            rw [h₁₉, hx']
            <;> simp [h₁₇]
            <;> field_simp [h₁₇]
            <;> ring
          exact h₁₈
        have h₁₄ : y = v ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
          have h₁₅ : v = y ^ (m - 1) := hy'
          have h₁₆ : y > 0 := hy
          have h₁₇ : v > 0 := hv
          have h₁₈ : (m - 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by linarith
          have h₁₉ : y = v ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
            have h₂₀ : y = (y ^ (m - 1)) ^ (1 / (m - 1)) := by
              have h₂₁ : y > 0 := hy
              have h₂₂ : (y ^ (m - 1) : ℝ) > 0 := by positivity
              have h₂₃ : (y ^ (m - 1) : ℝ) ^ (1 / (m - 1)) = y := by
                rw [← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt h₂₁)]
                <;> field_simp [h₁₈]
                <;> ring
              rw [h₂₃]
            rw [h₂₀, hy']
            <;> simp [h₁₈]
            <;> field_simp [h₁₈]
            <;> ring
          exact h₁₉
        calc
          x ^ m + y ^ m = (u ^ (1 / (m - 1)) : ℝ) ^ m + (v ^ (1 / (m - 1)) : ℝ) ^ m := by
            rw [h₁₃, h₁₄]
          _ = u ^ (m / (m - 1)) + v ^ (m / (m - 1)) := by
            have h₂₀ : (u ^ (1 / (m - 1)) : ℝ) ^ m = u ^ (m / (m - 1)) := by
              have h₂₁ : (u ^ (1 / (m - 1)) : ℝ) ^ m = u ^ ((1 / (m - 1)) * m) := by
                rw [← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hu)]
                <;> field_simp [h₁]
                <;> ring
              rw [h₂₁]
              have h₂₂ : ((1 / (m - 1) : ℝ) * m) = m / (m - 1) := by
                field_simp [h₁]
                <;> ring
              rw [h₂₂]
            have h₂₃ : (v ^ (1 / (m - 1)) : ℝ) ^ m = v ^ (m / (m - 1)) := by
              have h₂₄ : (v ^ (1 / (m - 1)) : ℝ) ^ m = v ^ ((1 / (m - 1)) * m) := by
                rw [← Real.rpow_mul (le_of_lt hv)]
                <;> field_simp [h₁]
                <;> ring
              rw [h₂₄]
              have h₂₅ : ((1 / (m - 1) : ℝ) * m) = m / (m - 1) := by
                field_simp [h₁]
                <;> ring
              rw [h₂₅]
            rw [h₂₀, h₂₃]
          _ = u ^ n + v ^ n := by
            have h₂₆ : n = m / (m - 1) := h₃
            rw [h₂₆]
          _ = 1 := by
            exact h₁₁
      exact h₁₂
    have h₁₀ : u = x ^ (m - 1) := hx'
    have h₁₁ : v = y ^ (m - 1) := hy'
    refine' ⟨x, hx, y, hy, h₈, h₉, h₁₀, h₁₁⟩
  
  refine' ⟨h_main_forward, h_main_backward⟩

theorem putnam_1968_a2
(a b c d e f : ℤ)
(ε : ℝ)
(hne : a * d ≠ b * c)
(hε : ε > 0)
: ∃ r s : ℚ, (|r * a + s * b - e| : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo 0 ε ∧ (|r * c + s * d - f| : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo 0 ε :=

  have h_main : ∃ (r s : ℚ), (|r * a + s * b - e| : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo 0 ε ∧ (|r * c + s * d - f| : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo 0 ε := by
    
    have h₁ : ∃ (n : ℕ), (n : ℝ) > 1 / ε := by
      
      have h₂ : ∃ (n : ℕ), (n : ℝ) > 1 / ε := by
        
        obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / ε)
        refine' ⟨n, _⟩
        exact_mod_cast hn
      exact h₂
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := h₁
    have h₂ : (n : ℝ) > 1 / ε := hn
    have h₃ : (1 : ℝ) / n < ε := by
      have h₄ : (0 : ℝ) < ε := by linarith
      have h₅ : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ε := by positivity
      have h₆ : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by
        by_contra h
        have h₇ : (n : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have h₈ : (n : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have h₉ : (1 : ℝ) / ε > 0 := by positivity
        have h₁₀ : (n : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have h₁₁ : (1 : ℝ) / ε > (n : ℝ) := by linarith
        have h₁₂ : (1 : ℝ) / n ≤ 0 := by
          by_cases h₁₃ : (n : ℝ) = 0
          · rw [h₁₃]
            norm_num
          · have h₁₄ : (n : ℝ) > 0 := by
              by_contra h₁₅
              have h₁₆ : (n : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by linarith
              have h₁₇ : (n : ℕ) = 0 := by
                by_contra h₁₈
                have h₁₉ : (n : ℕ) > 0 := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by intro h₂₀; simp_all)
                have h₂₀ : (n : ℝ) > 0 := by exact_mod_cast h₁₉
                linarith
              simp_all
            have h₂₁ : (1 : ℝ) / n > 0 := by positivity
            linarith
        linarith
      have h₂₂ : (1 : ℝ) / n < ε := by
        have h₂₃ : (1 : ℝ) / ε < (n : ℝ) := by linarith
        have h₂₄ : (1 : ℝ) / n < ε := by
          calc
            (1 : ℝ) / n < (1 : ℝ) / (1 / ε) := by
              apply one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt
              · positivity
              · linarith
            _ = ε := by
              field_simp
              <;> linarith
        exact h₂₄
      exact h₂₂
    
    have h₄ : ∃ (δ : ℚ), 0 < δ ∧ (δ : ℝ) < ε := by
      refine' ⟨1 / n, _⟩
      constructor
      · 
        positivity
      · 
        exact_mod_cast h₃
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, hδ_lt_ε⟩ := h₄
    
    have h₅ : ∃ (r s : ℚ), (r * a + s * b : ℚ) = e + δ ∧ (r * c + s * d : ℚ) = f + δ := by
      
      have h₆ : a * d ≠ b * c := hne
      have h₇ : (a : ℚ) * d ≠ b * c := by
        norm_cast at h₆ ⊢
        <;> simp_all
      
      have h₈ : ∃ (r s : ℚ), (r * a + s * b : ℚ) = e + δ ∧ (r * c + s * d : ℚ) = f + δ := by
        
        have h₉ : (a : ℚ) * d - b * c ≠ 0 := by
          intro h
          apply h₇
          linarith
        
        use ((e + δ) * d - (f + δ) * b) / (a * d - b * c), ((a * (f + δ) - c * (e + δ)) / (a * d - b * c))
        constructor
        · 
          field_simp [h₉, sub_ne_zero]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [h₉, sub_ne_zero] at *
          <;> ring_nf at *
          <;> norm_cast at *
          <;> simp_all
          <;> linarith
        · 
          field_simp [h₉, sub_ne_zero]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> field_simp [h₉, sub_ne_zero] at *
          <;> ring_nf at *
          <;> norm_cast at *
          <;> simp_all
          <;> linarith
      exact h₈
    obtain ⟨r, s, h₅₁, h₅₂⟩ := h₅
    
    have h₆ : (|r * a + s * b - e| : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo 0 ε := by
      have h₇ : (r * a + s * b : ℚ) = e + δ := by exact_mod_cast h₅₁
      have h₈ : (r * a + s * b : ℝ) = (e + δ : ℝ) := by
        norm_cast at h₇ ⊢
        <;> simp_all
        <;> ring_nf at *
        <;> norm_num at *
        <;> linarith
      have h₉ : (|r * a + s * b - e| : ℝ) = (δ : ℝ) := by
        rw [h₈]
        have h₁₀ : 0 < (δ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hδ_pos
        rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
        <;> ring_nf at *
        <;> norm_num at *
        <;> linarith
      rw [h₉]
      exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast hδ_pos, by exact_mod_cast hδ_lt_ε⟩
    have h₇ : (|r * c + s * d - f| : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo 0 ε := by
      have h₈ : (r * c + s * d : ℚ) = f + δ := by exact_mod_cast h₅₂
      have h₉ : (r * c + s * d : ℝ) = (f + δ : ℝ) := by
        norm_cast at h₈ ⊢
        <;> simp_all
        <;> ring_nf at *
        <;> norm_num at *
        <;> linarith
      have h₁₀ : (|r * c + s * d - f| : ℝ) = (δ : ℝ) := by
        rw [h₉]
        have h₁₁ : 0 < (δ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hδ_pos
        rw [abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
        <;> ring_nf at *
        <;> norm_num at *
        <;> linarith
      rw [h₁₀]
      exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast hδ_pos, by exact_mod_cast hδ_lt_ε⟩
    exact ⟨r, s, h₆, h₇⟩
  
  obtain ⟨r, s, h₁, h₂⟩ := h_main
  exact ⟨r, s, h₁, h₂⟩

theorem putnam_1971_b1
(S : Type*) [Mul S]
(hself : ∀ x : S, x * x = x)
(h2 : ∀ x y z : S, (x * y) * z = (y * z) * x)
: (∀ x y z : S, (x * y) * z = x * (y * z)) ∧ (∀ x y : S, x * y = y * x) :=
by
 
  have h_step1 : ∀ (x y : S), (x * y) * x = x * y := by
    intro x y
    have h1 : (x * y) * x = (y * x) * x := by
      have h2' := h2 x y x
      exact h2'
    have h2 : (y * x) * x = x * y := by
      have h3 : (y * x) * x = (x * x) * y := by
        have h4 := h2 y x x
        exact h4
      have h4 : (x * x) * y = x * y := by
        have h5 : x * x = x := hself x
        rw [h5]
      rw [h3, h4]
    rw [h1, h2]
  
  have h_step2 : ∀ (x y : S), (x * y) * y = y * x := by
    intro x y
    have h1 : (x * y) * y = (y * y) * x := by
      have h2' := h2 x y y
      exact h2'
    have h2 : (y * y) * x = y * x := by
      have h3 : y * y = y := hself y
      rw [h3]
    rw [h1, h2]
  
  have h_comm : ∀ (x y : S), x * y = y * x := by
    intro x y
    have h1 : x * y = (y * (x * y)) * x := by
      have h3 : (x * y) * (x * y) = (y * (x * y)) * x := by
        have h4 := h2 x y (x * y)
        exact h4
      have h4 : (x * y) * (x * y) = x * y := hself (x * y)
      rw [h4] at h3
      exact h3
    have h2 : (y * (x * y)) * x = (x * y) * y := by
      have h3 := h2 y (x * y) x
      have h4 : (y * (x * y)) * x = ((x * y) * x) * y := by
        have h5 := h2 y (x * y) x
        exact h5
      have h5 : ((x * y) * x) * y = (x * y) * y := by
        have h6 : (x * y) * x = x * y := h_step1 x y
        rw [h6]
        <;> simp [h_step2, hself]
        <;>
        (try ring_nf) <;>
        (try simp_all) <;>
        (try ring_nf at *) <;>
        (try simp_all)
      rw [h4, h5]
    have h3 : (x * y) * y = y * x := h_step2 x y
    rw [h1, h2, h3]
    <;> simp_all
  
  have h_assoc : ∀ (x y z : S), (x * y) * z = x * (y * z) := by
    intro x y z
    have h1 : (x * y) * z = (y * z) * x := by
      have h2' := h2 x y z
      exact h2'
    have h2 : (y * z) * x = x * (y * z) := by
      have h3 : x * (y * z) = (y * z) * x := by
        rw [h_comm]
      rw [h3]
      <;> simp_all
    rw [h1, h2]
    <;> simp_all
  
  exact ⟨h_assoc, h_comm⟩

theorem putnam_1971_b1
(S : Type*) [Mul S]
(hself : ∀ x : S, x * x = x)
(h2 : ∀ x y z : S, (x * y) * z = (y * z) * x)

        have h16 : (y * x) * y = (x * y) * y := by

theorem putnam_1984_b2

    constructor

      have h₁ : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo 0 √2 := by

          nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg 2, Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 by norm_num)]

        rw [h₄]

    · 
      rintro y ⟨u, v, hu, hv, rfl⟩

        rw [h₂]

        have h₄ : u < √2 := by

            have h₉ : u > 0 := h₃
            have h₁₀ : u < √2 := h₄
            have h₁₁ : 0 < √2 := by positivity
            have h₁₂ : u ^ 2 < 2 := by nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 by norm_num)]
            have h₁₃ : Real.sqrt (2 - u ^ 2) ≥ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
            nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2 - u ^ 2 by nlinarith),
              sq_nonneg (u - 1), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt (2 - u ^ 2) - 1)]
          have h₉ : u - v + Real.sqrt (2 - u ^ 2) - 9 / v ≤ -4 := by
            have h₁₀ : u + Real.sqrt (2 - u ^ 2) ≤ 2 := h₈
            have h₁₁ : v + 9 / v ≥ 6 := h₇
            have h₁₂ : u - v + Real.sqrt (2 - u ^ 2) - 9 / v ≤ -4 := by
              have h₁₃ : u - v + Real.sqrt (2 - u ^ 2) - 9 / v = u + Real.sqrt (2 - u ^ 2) - (v + 9 / v) := by ring
              rw [h₁₃]
              have h₁₄ : u + Real.sqrt (2 - u ^ 2) ≤ 2 := h₁₀
              have h₁₅ : v + 9 / v ≥ 6 := h₁₁
              nlinarith
            exact h₁₂
          have h₁₀ : (u - v + Real.sqrt (2 - u ^ 2) - 9 / v) ^ 2 ≥ 16 := by
            have h₁₁ : u - v + Real.sqrt (2 - u ^ 2) - 9 / v ≤ -4 := h₉
            nlinarith
          exact h₁₀
        have h₇ : (u - v) ^ 2 + (Real.sqrt (2 - u ^ 2) - 9 / v) ^ 2 ≥ 8 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u - v + Real.sqrt (2 - u ^ 2) - 9 / v),

          rw [hunion]
          exact h₅

      have h₉ : a * b * (u * v) ∉ T ∩ U := by
        rw [hdisj]
        simp [Set.ext_iff]
      exact h₉ h₈
  exact h_main
